One judgment call surfaced by the RTM checker: REQ-018 (the Settings file, no checker test of its own) needed a test_id assigned to the always-on manifest result -- M2-S05-T4 -- as a deliberate, disclosed exception to the inlining convention every earlier step's manifest result followed, to avoid manufacturing a fresh coverage-gap ERROR. No pre-existing row anywhere was touched. Set M2-S05 tested -> documented via build_plan.py set-status.
confidence_rationale: REQ-018's placement required judgment on two counts the Step 11 MEDIUM row names directly: the Settings file is a supporting artefact for two other requirements rather than an addressable artefact of its own, and its traceability row needed a test_id assigned outside the established xml/manifest-inlining convention to satisfy check_rtm.py's coverage-gap rule. Every other row (REQ-016, REQ-017, CWB-PATH-001/002) met the HIGH bar cleanly: a real source_req_id, a resolvable recommended_agent, and a non-empty verification cell.

check_sales_process_mapping.py's declared step-scope test exits 0 with 'Scanned 0 file(s) -- nothing asserted', a plan defect the step's own deploy-order.md section 7 already names with three remedies, none of which is this agent's to apply. Recorded as O-M2S05-01 rather than let a green test list imply content was checked that was not.

Whether Renewal_Opportunity_Path renders to any user depends on whether Northwind's current Opportunity Lightning record page already carries the Path component -- M3-S05 (pending) rebuilds the Enterprise page only. Nothing in this build asserts the Renewal page's state either way; O-M2S05-04 carries the retrieve-and-grep a human needs to run before the M2 gate.
M2-S05 is now documented; M2-S04 (built and tested in parallel) is the last M2 step short of documented before milestone-verifier applies over the whole milestone.
